answers.core: Vehicles are extremely common in games. Expanding the possibilities of the built-in wheels beyond simple raycasts would reduce a lot of repetitious problem-solving. At the very least, the inclusion of a width variable would I think be useful to everyone.
answers.workaround: No. This would involve either writing your own wheel node or modifying the engine to expose the Jolt functionality.

title: Add support for wheel thickness and shape customization in VehicleWheel3D
